enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fire Shield (Cold): You permanently benefit from Fire Shield (Cold), which protects you from Fire Damage and harms those who attack you. You are also permanently warded against Fire Shield (Hot).
Constitution +4: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Dusk: Equipping this item engulfs you in twilight shadows. Attacks from enemies have a 10% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Spell Resistance +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
